description: A step waits for the game to stop again and answers with the stack, or with heldAgain false after ten seconds. pause and step_out need a game this server started. To stop an editor-played game, set a breakpoint. Operations: pause: stop the game where it is and answer with the stack; continue: resume after a breakpoint; step_over: run the current line; step_into: run the current line and stop inside whatever it calls; step_out: run to the end of the current function.
name: debug_control
title: Step the debugger
